attributes.action: Require transparency on corporate water extraction charges
attributes.additional_details: Request that the government publish a detailed breakdown of extraction charges for high-volume users and outline measures to ensure a fair balance of costs between commercial and residential sectors.
attributes.background: We call on the government to review and provide full transparency on the charging scheme used by the Environment Agency for large-scale corporate water extraction. It is vital that the public understands how these corporate costs are determined in comparison to the rates paid by domestic bill payers

rejection.details:
The scheme referred to is already in the public domain, in some detail:

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a05f03922977ebc82cb3fcb/The_Environment_Agency_Environmental_Permitting_and_Abstraction_Licensing_England_Charging_Scheme_2022_Amendments_up_to_15_May_2026.pdf
